title: Guard a service with an access control proxy
description: AdminService exposes sensitive operations. SecureServiceProxy wraps it and checks the caller's role before delegating. ADMIN callers get full access; any other role receives an UnauthorizedException. Implement SecureServiceProxy so it enforces this rule without modifying AdminService.
hints: SecureServiceProxy implements the same Service interface as AdminService
Store the caller's role in the proxy and check it before each call
Throw UnauthorizedException (provided) when the role is not ADMIN
issues: Without a proxy, access control must be duplicated inside every service method or at every call site
AdminService itself cannot change its public interface to add security without breaking callers
overallGoal: Use the Protection Proxy pattern to enforce role-based access control transparently, keeping AdminService itself free of security logic.
goals: ADMIN callers can invoke all service methods successfully
Non-ADMIN callers receive UnauthorizedException without the real service being called
SecureServiceProxy implements the same interface as AdminService
